knownFlakiness.evidence: db073ce4 modifies only five pre-existing lines of scripts/web-ui-browser-e2e.mjs, all default parameters on startServer() and startChrome(); every other change is an insertion guarded by `if (SCREENSHOTS)`, which is null without the opt-in --screenshots flag. The graph empty-state probe, mapPixels and the browser launch flags on the gate path are byte-identical to c0066d95, and the ui/ runtime is unchanged, so the flake is pre-existing and simply did not fire during the 236d7362 or c0066d95 runs.
knownFlakiness.likelyCause: NOT_PROVEN: the full-canvas value is consistent with a WebGL clear/compositor readback race in which the canvas is sampled before the empty scene settles, but no root cause was isolated and no fix was attempted.
knownFlakiness.remediation: Left unfixed on purpose: this receipt commit is restricted to docs/verification, and changing the gate script would invalidate the SHA these gates ran on. Recorded here so the next candidate can address it deliberately.

releaseConclusion: Twelve of the thirteen gates PASS outright on the clean final v0.5.0 candidate db073ce4, and the thirteenth passes on re-run: typecheck, a build that reproduced the tracked dist/, 98 files / 1015 Vitest tests, 26 Codex slices, 105 total slices, installer, marketplace, packaged runtime (memex-0.5.0.tgz, 311 files, 9 MCP tools), offline lifecycle 9/9, 82 Workspace unit tests, isolated plugin validation (11 substitute checks, matching 0.5.0 plugin and MCP server versions) and the benchmark contract. The real-Chrome Memex Workspace E2E is recorded as PASS-ON-RERUN: its first attempt on this SHA failed the graph empty-state assertion with the whole canvas counted as painted, then it passed, and 12 runs on this SHA gave 10 passes and 2 failures. That flake is not attributed to this commit — the gate path is byte-identical apart from two default-parameter signatures, and everything else added is guarded behind the opt-in --screenshots flag — but it is a real stability defect in the gate and is recorded in knownFlakiness rather than papered over. Every gate was re-executed on this SHA rather than inherited from the superseded c0066d95 receipt, because README.md and scripts/ ship inside the package; the tarball file count correctly stayed at 311 since assets/ is outside the package.json files list. The full acceptance benchmark was NOT re-run: it is referenced as prior evidence measured on 236d7362 (PASS, 6/6 AC_PERF groups, knowledge map through `loopback HTTP /api/v2/graph` with 50 nodes and 49 edges on the native LOCAL WEBGL renderer), and the contract gate confirms that report still satisfies the committed contract. Live user data, an authenticated Codex tier run, the formal plugin validator, deterministic stability of the Workspace browser gate, benchmark numbers for this exact SHA, real-world performance, model quality and the accuracy of the rewritten README prose and screenshots are NOT_PROVEN.
